question: Which of the following countries won the Presidency of International Institute of Administrative Sciences for the term 2025-28?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** won the **Presidency** of the **International Institute of Administrative Sciences (IIAS)** for the term **2025-28**. This significant victory marks a major milestone for the country in the field of global administrative reforms and public governance.
 
• The election for the Presidency took place during the **IIAS Annual Conference 2024**, which was held in **Mombasa, Kenya**, in **February 2024**. India's candidacy was strongly supported by various member nations.
 
• **S. Chockalingam**, a **1996-batch IAS officer** and the **Director General** of the **Yashwantrao Chavan Academy of Development Administration (YASHADA)** in **Pune**, was elected as the **President-elect**. He will represent India at the helm of this prestigious international body.
 
• India's victory is seen as a recognition of its robust **administrative framework** and its continuous efforts toward **digital transformation** and **citizen-centric governance**. The **Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG)**, under the **Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions**, led the institutional representation for India.
 
• With this Presidency, India will play a pivotal role in shaping the global agenda for **public administration**, fostering international cooperation, and sharing best practices in **governance** and **public policy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **International Institute of Administrative Sciences (IIAS):**

 
 
• Established in **1930**, the **IIAS** is a global federation headquartered in **Brussels, Belgium**.
 
• It focuses on improving **administrative sciences** and **public administration** through research, training, and the exchange of knowledge among governments and academic institutions.
 
• It currently comprises several member states, national sections, and academic entities, serving as a platform for **comparative public administration** studies.
 
 
 
• **Role of DARPG:**
 
 
• The **Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG)** is the nodal agency for the Government of India for **administrative reforms**.
 
• Under the leadership of Secretary **V. Srinivas**, the department has been actively promoting India's **administrative achievements** on international forums.
 
• The department is responsible for formulating policies for **grievance redressal**, **e-governance**, and **disseminating best practices** across various sectors.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Presidency:**
 
 
• Winning the Presidency allows **India** to lead the **Council of Administration** and the **Executive Committee** of the IIAS.
 
• It provides an opportunity for **India** to influence global **governance standards** and showcase the **"Minimum Government, Maximum Governance"** philosophy.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **2025 IIAS Annual Conference:**

 
 
• As part of its rising leadership, **India** is set to host the **2025 IIAS Annual Conference** in **Kochi, Kerala**.
 
• The conference is scheduled to be held from **February 24 to 28, 2025**.
 
• The theme for the **2025 Kochi Conference** is **"Next Generation Administrative Reforms - Empowering the Citizens and Reaching the Last Mile"**.
 
• This event will bring together over **30 countries** and **administrative experts** to discuss **digital governance**, **institutional capacity building**, and **sustainable development goals (SDGs)**.
 
 
 
• **Historical Context:**
 
 
• This is the **first time** an **Indian official** has been elected to the post of **President** of the **IIAS** since its inception in **1930**.
 
• India has been a member of the IIAS for decades, but this **2025-2028 term** marks its highest level of institutional involvement and leadership.
